name: Exxelia CalRamic Technologies LLC
old_description: CalRamic Technologies LLC, is a U.S.-based High Voltage Ceramic Capacitor manufacturer with over 30 years’ experience.  Our team focuses on producing exceptional quality capacitors by using superior quality materials with a highly trained team.
about:
Exxelia CalRamic Technologies LLC operates from Reno, Nevada, where it has spent over 30 years manufacturing high-voltage ceramic capacitors. The company was established as a U.S.-based specialist in ceramic capacitor production, focusing on quality materials and a highly trained team.

The product line spans configurations from 500 VDC to 80 KVDC, including MLCC leaded capacitors, high-voltage surface-mount and multilayer chip capacitors, SMPS capacitors, leaded disc capacitors, and custom designs. High-temperature variants rated to 200 °C are also produced. Lean manufacturing principles support rapid prototype turnaround, multiple design derivations, and a range of dielectric options. The company ships in-stock items the same day and serves customers in more than 200 countries.

Capacitors are supplied to defense and commercial aviation, radar systems, geothermal and downhole drilling, flight-control instruments, satellite communications, power generation, and deep-space exploration programs. Additional markets include commercial and industrial equipment, medical devices, commercial aerospace, ground-based military, military aerospace, and high-reliability space satellite systems.

The company emphasizes its 30-plus years of materials engineering expertise, a quality system that exceeds ISO 9001:2015 requirements, and a culture of team-based problem solving. It also maintains an educational library of application notes and training modules to help customers specify the right component.
